layout.grid_strategy: MODE B: THE CONTROL ROOM GRID

components.map: Interactive Map container using react-simple-maps or leaflet (dark mode tiles) to avoid token issues, or react-map-gl if a Mapbox token is mocked. Include heat map overlay (red/orange) and distinct markers for strikes vs interceptions.
components.charts: Recharts. Use sharp lines (type='linear'), no curves. Grid lines should be very subtle (stroke-opacity: 0.1).
components.tables: Dense, clean, no rounded corners. Monospace fonts for numbers, costs, and coordinates.
components.buttons: Square edges or 2px radius. 1px solid border. High contrast hover states.

icons: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react - use for a technical, crisp look.

heatmap_texture.description: Background texture for the map or hero area to give a tactical glow.

motion.entrance: Staggered fade-in for list items and cards.
motion.map: Smooth flyTo transitions when selecting specific conflict zones.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets APCA standards. Use Text Shadow on map overlays.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a dark theme tactical command center dashboard tracking missile launches and conflicts.
Build a bento-grid layout for key metrics: Missiles Launched, Intercepted (success rate), Casualties (Deceased/Injured), and Estimated Cost of missiles.
Integrate an interactive map component with strike location markers and a heatmap overlay showing strike intensity.
Create a timeline chart (Recharts) showing strikes over time since conflicts started (e.g., Russia-Ukraine, Israel-Gaza/Lebanon/Iran).
Add a breakdown widget for missile types (Ballistic, Cruise, Drone) vs Counter-missiles (Patriot, Iron Dome, etc.) with their respective costs and interception rates.
Use 'Barlow Condensed' for strong, authoritative headers and 'IBM Plex Sans' for legible data points and body.
Apply 'data-testid' to all buttons, tabs, and interactive controls.
